cases.name: Batteriespeicher
cases.contract: Stromport BUS_A, injection-positive MW; conditional energy ledger MWh, losses, initial and any source-approved terminal
cases.positive: 2 MW charging for 0.5 h = 1 MWh grid intake before efficiency
cases.negative: 2 MWh inferred or missing terminal owner rule

cases.name: EV-Flotte
cases.contract: individuelle Abfahrtsenergie/Anschlussfenster, V2G nur bei expliziter Erlaubnis
cases.variants: individual vehicles versus aggregate service envelope with per-vehicle witness
cases.positive: service witness fulfils each declared deadline
cases.negative: aggregate MWh right but EV2 misses departure
cases.comparison: E5 conditional; service universally not proved

cases.name: Elektrolyse
cases.contract: electricity consumption MW and H2 mass production kg/h; LHV/HHV explicit
cases.variants: constant vs piecewise efficiency constrained to external envelope
cases.positive: output and electricity flow respect stated efficiency envelope
cases.negative: MW compared to kg/h or missing heating value
cases.comparison: E5 conditional; nonlinearity allowed by contract

cases.name: H2-Speicher
cases.contract: H2 kg/h port, mass ledger, losses; energy basis if explicitly approved
cases.variants: kg inventory vs energy inventory with stated conversion
cases.positive: ledger conserved on shared declared basis
cases.negative: kg treated as MWh or HHV/LHV substituted
cases.rewrite: R06 only with explicit approved conversion

cases.name: Elektrisches Netz
cases.contract: lossless DC assumption; KCL AND KVL; branches/buses distinct, oriented flows
cases.variants: angles/DC Ohm versus cycle/PTDF with proof obligations
cases.positive: 3-bus flows satisfy nodal and loop balances
cases.negative: circulating flow satisfies KCL but violates KVL

cases.name: Netzausbau
cases.contract: admissible expansion choices, lead time, modularity if specified, capex
cases.variants: two discrete formulations or continuous only with approved policy
cases.positive: integer module result for discrete-required scope
cases.rewrite: R06 MW only; never erase integrality

cases.name: Investition / Information
cases.contract: scenario tree, decision time and information partitions; nonanticipativity
cases.variants: one shared first-stage decision versus scenario-indexed equalities
cases.positive: pre-revelation decisions equal in same information set
cases.negative: future weather revelation changes first-stage choice
cases.rewrite: R02 on sets but not stage order
cases.comparison: E4 not inferred from one scenario sample

cases.name: KPI / Kosten
cases.contract: cost inventory, currency/price year, discount, scenario/time weights and selection
cases.positive: same total after exact unit+weight reconciliation
cases.negative: omits time weight or double-counts CAPEX
cases.comparison: E3 sampled values possible; E4 not inferred

cases.name: CBA / Counterfactual
cases.contract: project-baseline pairing, shared exogenous conditions, discount and authority; N2E owner unresolved
cases.variants: integrated modelling versus independent CBA postprocess
cases.positive: synthetic matched baseline differential with same price convention
cases.negative: counterfactual demand altered without approved scope
cases.rewrite: R02 indicator-set only; owner not defaulted

cases.name: Multi-Model
cases.contract: common study/data/scenario/observable IDs, variation and independent evidence
cases.variants: two different internal model structures with separate projections
cases.positive: both disclose variation and individual evidence
cases.negative: unsupported E4 assertion from equal objective or concealed extra assumption
cases.comparison: E5 only on two separately supported conformances
